title: Configure and smoke-test NASA POWER acquisition

acceptance.text: A versioned 64-point POWER configuration and resilient downloader are verified with synthetic tests and exactly four live smoke requests, without starting the full historical collection or changing G0.
acceptance.evidence: Verified the Step 1 registry checksum; generated a 64-point, 2001-2025 LST/AG configuration with 1,600 annual requests; implemented validated/resumable acquisition and seven synthetic tests. Exactly four live smoke requests for Bagerhat/Rangamati in January 2001/2025 returned 31 dates each, expected parameters/units/LST/fill metadata, no fill values and preserved raw SHA-256 evidence.
